title: agent-spawn stop --json
description: Exit 0: the agent is parked per the outcome table (a stopped run: killed, stopped, no attention; a run that had already reported keeps its outcome; never resumed automatically or promoted), was already parked, or its record was removed (removed true). stop records nothing on the agent. Exit 12 (still live after the wait) and claude-session's 10 and 20 print the error envelope.

agent.description: The agent after the stop; null exactly when removed is true.

action.description: session_stop: claude-session stop of the pending or live current run (a promotion's pending run and supervisor_lost included); signal_supervisor: SIGTERM to the verified supervisor between runs (no pending run); signal_launcher: SIGTERM to the verified launcher (launching, before start returned); none: nothing to stop.

session_stop.description: claude-session stop --json result (with --dry-run: stop --dry-run), verbatim; null unless action is session_stop.

already_parked.description: true: the agent was parked, or tearing_down without a pending or live run; a no-op (action none).

removed.description: true: the agent's record disappeared during the wait (a launching fork deleted by its launcher before its session existed, or an abandoned fork); counts as done (exit 0).
